data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit finishes a [Fall Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back), [Normal](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) or [Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move).

**Target:** A **HERETIC ASTARTES INFANTRY** or **HERETIC ASTARTES MOUNTED** unit of yours that is not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit and is up to 8" from that enemy unit.

**Effect:** The unit can move up to 6" as a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move).
